about: Fresh held-out set 5 (100 notes, written 2026-10-08 BEFORE any embedding-model results were used to tune a hybrid). Run once at the very end for an honest score, then fold into the dev sets.
notes: Bus conductor gave me the exact change without me asking and I felt weirdly seen
Mom called at 7am just to say good luck for the exam. Ate her aloo paratha in my head the whole way.
Result day. Scrolling the portal with my eyes half shut.
Got 87 in Maths!! I literally did a little dance in the corridor
The tram ride home was so slow and so lovely, golden light all the way
Fought with Dada about nothing and now the whole house is quiet
Rain started right as I left the metro and I just walked in it, didn't even take the umbrella out
Lab record due tomorrow and I haven't even started the third experiment
Aaj bohot thak gayi, bas bed pe girna hai
Pehli baar akele movie dekhne gayi aur mazaa aaya
Kolkata book fair with Tuli, bought way more than I can afford and zero regrets

My laptop charger died the night before submission, running around the neighbourhood at 10pm
Maa made payesh because it's my birthday and I almost cried at the first spoon
Skipped breakfast, skipped lunch, skipped sleep. Productive? Not even.
The new bakery near college has the best cheese toast, I am never going home hungry again

Sat by the Ganga at Prinsep Ghat till the lights came on. No phone.
Told Baba I cleared the entrance and he hugged me for a long time

Walked the whole way back from New Market holding a bag of momos and a cheap earring I couldn't resist
Why is everyone's life moving forward except mine
Durga Puja pandal design this year is unreal, stood in the queue 2 hours and it was worth it
Slept through my alarm, missed the first lecture, and my friend marked my attendance. Legend.
Fever 101. Ma is making me drink some awful kadha.
Cycling through the lanes of north Kolkata at dawn, nobody awake, just chai wallahs and crows

Friday night on the terrace with chips and old songs, nobody wants to go down

Kal exam hai aur main Netflix pe hoon. Bahut bura lag raha hai

The smell of first rain on dry earth. I stopped in the middle of the road.
Mashi sent a parcel with nolen gur sandesh and pickles from home 😭
Watched the entire match with my cousins, we lost but it was still the best night
Mess is closed for the holidays so it's maggi for the third night in a row, and I'm not even mad
Can't believe I cried at an ad. A tea ad.

My best friend's engagement. I'm happy for her and also terrified of how fast everything is changing
Spent the day helping Dida sort her old photographs. She told me a story for each one.

Finally started running again. 2 km and I wanted to die but I did it.
It's pouring and the street outside is a river, auto fare tripled, missed the interview
Cooked biryani for the first time and nobody complained. Even Ma asked for seconds.
just woke up from a nap and the sky is orange and my room smells like rain 🧡
Group of boys keep commenting at me every day near the tea stall. I'm tired of changing my route.
She remembered my favourite song and played it without telling me. I'm going to be okay.
Turned 21 today. Nothing feels different but everything feels different.
The chai was too sweet, the auto was late, and the sky was pretty, so overall a draw
The viva went better than I thought, the external even smiled at my answer
Ma's cough is back and she won't see a doctor. I'm so worried I can't concentrate.
Wrote ten pages for my story tonight, no idea if they're any good but my hands didn't stop
Stood in front of the mirror and for once did not hate what I saw
No power, no wifi, candlelight dinner with the whole family, we told ghost stories
Walking past the school gate and the bell rang and my heart actually did a thing
Aajke onek bhalo laglo, Ma-er hater roshogolla kheye mon bhore gelo
The sunsets from the 11th-floor window these days are making me emotional for no reason
Missed two classes for the cricket match and the teacher marked me absent 😭 worth it though
Spent the afternoon dyeing fabric with Tia, our hands are blue and I've never been happier
Aaj mon ta ekdom bhalo nei, kichu bhalo lagche na
Rows of lamps on the ghats, the aarti bell, my grandmother's hand in mine
Another rejection email. Seventeenth. I stopped counting for a reason.
We finally painted our little room and moved all the furniture. It feels like ours now.
Went to the dentist and cried like a baby but Ma bought me an ice cream after
The bookstore uncle kept my favourite book aside for a week for me. People are kind.
I opened the fridge nine times hoping something new would appear
Overheard two strangers in the metro talking about their mothers and I teared up a bit
Everything is exactly as it should be right now. Tea, window, rain.
Presentation in 20 minutes and my hands are ice cold
Today I said no to something I didn't want to do and nobody died
My roommate left the stove on again. I'm taking over the kitchen.
Eid at Shibu's place, sewai, biryani and hugs till my ribs hurt
Nothing happened today and honestly that's the nicest thing

Ma's sad voice on the phone and I can't do anything from here, 400 km away

The village pond, ducks, Dida's mango pickle drying on the roof. Holidays done right.

A whole day of nothing planned and I read two books and took a nap in the sun

A little girl on the bus gave me her half-eaten biscuit and I will carry that with me forever
I keep thinking about her laugh. It's inconvenient.
Dida's stories on the veranda while the monsoon hammered the tin roof
